notes.title: Demo update
notes.notes:
Hi!
We've just released an updated demo of A Western Drama, wich includes the full first chapter of the story. In this latest version you will find the soundtrack and the improvement of some mechanics.
If you like the game, don't forget to add it to your wishlist :)

notes.title: A Western Drama Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hi!
We're TriBit Studio, a small italian team focused on creating high accessibility games and apps.

Today we finally released our first audiogame, A Western Drama, a spaghetti-western arcade without any graphics. In our game, the player is immersed in a 3D audio-environment and needs to use his hearing to explore cities and mines, get out alive from violent shootouts and duel the most badass scoundrels on the frontier, living a story in in the typical spaghetti western style.

We've always loved western stories, having grown up with movies like For a Fistful of Dollars, Django, Once Upon a Time in the West and the others, and we strongly believe in gaming for everyone, so we simply decided to merge the two :)

We hope you will enjoy our game!
